World Cup Matches Conclude, Some Teams Advance to Semifinals

Several FIFA World Cup quarterfinal matches have concluded, with teams like England, Spain, and Argentina securing spots in the semifinals. While some matches featured dramatic late winners and extra-time victories, others highlighted individual player performances and broader impacts of the tournament. One report also noted crowd disturbances in London following a team's exit.
